summary: Backend + Frontend validation of the NEW Emergent-managed Google Sign-In feature (optional). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_google_auth.py) after fixing a missing `timezone` import in server.py that was causing /api/auth/me to 500 on any valid or expired session lookup. Coverage: POST /api/auth/google/session (invalid session_id → 401 'Invalid session ID', empty body → 422, missing body → 422); GET /api/auth/me (no header → 401 'Not authenticated', garbage bearer → 401 'Invalid session', non-Bearer scheme → 401); POST /api/auth/logout (no header → 200 {status: logged_out}, garbage bearer → 200); Mongo indexes verified on startup — google_users.email unique, google_users.user_id unique, user_sessions.session_token unique, user_sessions.expires_at TTL(expireAfterSeconds=0); full simulated flow via direct Mongo inserts — valid session token → GET /auth/me returns user (user_id/email/name), expired session token → 401 'Session expired' AND row is deleted by get_google_user, POST /auth/logout with valid token → row removed and subsequent /auth/me returns 401; regression on /api/store/config and /api/codes/channels still 200. Frontend (mobile 390x844): /chirpconnect SETTINGS shows ACCOUNT section with 'SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE' button positioned ABOVE IDENTITY (bounding y=161 vs 276). Clicking the button issued a top-level navigation to `https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fbinaural-preview.preview.emergentagent.com%2F` — decoded redirect exactly equals window.location.origin + '/' ✓. /mirrors-id logged-out view also renders the Google button. Loading '/#session_id=fake123' cleaned the hash via history.replaceState (window.location.hash === ''), left localStorage.google_session_token null (backend rejected fake123), and app rendered without crash. Simulated returning session by seeding google_users + user_sessions in Mongo and setting localStorage.google_session_token → /chirpconnect SETTINGS displayed the signed-in card (name 'UITEST User', email visible, SIGN OUT button visible, zero 'SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE' occurrences); tapping SIGN OUT cleared localStorage token and the SIGN IN button returned. Regression: IDENTITY, CHAT STYLE, HAPTIC sections still render on /chirpconnect SETTINGS; home page '/' loads normally. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av still present (pre-existing warning from iteration 3, not caused by this feature).

critical_code_review_comments: BUG (fixed): server.py used `timezone.utc` in the Google auth path but only imported `datetime, timedelta` — every request to /api/auth/me with a real session was returning 500 NameError until iteration 4 patched the import.

Session token model relies entirely on the token being unguessable and stored in DB; there is no JWT signature. That's fine given TTL + unique index, but any future attempt to make session tokens deterministic should be avoided.

google_create_session performs 4 sequential awaits (httpx GET → find_one → update/insert_one → user_sessions.update_one → find_one). A single Mongo transaction is unnecessary at this scale, but consider consolidating the final find_one by returning the freshly-built user dict.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the 500 on /api/auth/me: server.py imported only `datetime, timedelta` from datetime but the Google auth path (lines 1673-1674, 1708, 1717) references `timezone.utc`. Any request with a real Bearer token hit `expires.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` and raised NameError → FastAPI returned 500. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/google/session with a valid session_id (or direct Mongo insert of user_sessions + google_users) and then GET /api/auth/me with that token — the test suite reproduces this deterministically without needing a real Google login. Fix applied: extended the import on line 17 to `from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone` and restarted backend via supervisorctl. All 17 tests pass post-fix; UI signed-in flow also confirmed working end-to-end.
